about:
DMV JDM Depot, Inc. is based in Arbutus, Maryland. The company supplies used and remanufactured engines and transmissions sourced from Japan, with mileage typically between 55,000 and 65,000 miles.

The company inspects and quality-tests each unit before offering it for sale. Inventory is held in the United States and shipped domestically, with residential liftgate or tailgate delivery available. The product range covers engines and transmissions for a broad lineup of vehicle makes, including Acura, Honda, Toyota, Nissan, Subaru, and numerous other brands. Customers can locate parts by year-make-model or by VIN decoding.

DMV JDM Depot serves the automotive aftermarket, providing replacement powertrain components to repair shops, dealerships, and individual vehicle owners. The catalog spans popular models such as the Toyota Prius hybrid engine, Nissan Versa CVT transmission, Subaru Outback engine, and Hyundai and Kia engines.

The business emphasizes its U.S.-based stock, low-mileage JDM sourcing, and pre-sale inspection process as key differentiators. It also highlights expert advice before and after purchase and straightforward payment options.
